Container.Name: BorgWarehouse
Container.Overview:
BorgWarehouse is a fast, modern web interface for running a BorgBackup server. It turns your Unraid server into a central destination for Borg backups from your other machines: create and manage repositories, assign SSH keys, set quotas, monitor backup status and storage use, and get alerts by email or Apprise when a backup is late. Clients back up over SSH using borg, Vorta or borgmatic.
Before installing: generate two secrets for BETTER_AUTH_SECRET and CRONJOB_KEY (for example with "openssl rand -base64 32" in the Unraid terminal), and set SSH_SERVER_PORT to the same value as the SSH host port. Unraid's own SSH already uses port 22, so the default here is 2222.
Status and storage checks run on a schedule outside the container. Install the User Scripts plugin and add the script from the support page to keep the dashboard up to date.
OIDC single sign-on (Authentik, Keycloak, Zitadel and others), SMTP and the LAN settings are under Show more settings.
Container.Requires: Optional but recommended: the User Scripts plugin, to run BorgWarehouse's scheduled status and storage checks. See the support page for the script.
Container.ExtraSearchTerms: borg borgbackup backup vorta borgmatic ssh repository

Config.Name: Web UI port
Config.Description: Port for the BorgWarehouse web interface.

Config.Name: SSH port
Config.Description: Port Borg clients connect to over SSH. Unraid's own SSH uses 22, so pick another port. SSH_SERVER_PORT below must match this value.

Config.Name: Repositories
Config.Description: Where the Borg repositories are stored. Backups can be large, so use a share on the array (or a pool sized for it) rather than appdata.

Config.Name: Config
Config.Description: Application config and user database.

Config.Name: SSH authorized keys
Config.Description: Client public keys managed by BorgWarehouse (authorized_keys).

Config.Name: SSH host keys
Config.Description: The server's SSH host keys, generated on first start. Keep this so clients don't see a host key warning after an update.

Config.Name: FQDN
Config.Description: Hostname or IP address that Borg clients use to reach this server. It appears in the backup commands BorgWarehouse shows you, e.g. tower.local or backup.example.com.

Config.Name: SSH_SERVER_PORT
Config.Description: Must match the SSH host port above. It appears in the backup commands BorgWarehouse shows you.

Config.Name: BETTER_AUTH_URL
Config.Description: The main URL you open BorgWarehouse at, including http:// or https:// and any port, e.g. https://borg.example.com or http://192.168.1.10:3000. Logins from any other address are refused (Invalid origin in the log), so add the others to BETTER_AUTH_TRUSTED_ORIGINS under Show more settings.

Config.Name: BETTER_AUTH_SECRET
Config.Description: Secret used to sign login sessions. Generate with: openssl rand -base64 32. If empty, a new one is made at every restart and everyone is logged out.

Config.Name: CRONJOB_KEY
Config.Description: Key for the scheduled status and storage checks. Generate with: openssl rand -base64 32. The User Scripts script reads it from the container, so you don't need to copy it anywhere.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User ID the app runs as. 99 is Unraid's nobody user. Must not be 0.

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group ID the app runs as. 100 is Unraid's users group. Must not be 0.

Config.Name: OIDC_ISSUER_URL
Config.Description: OIDC issuer URL (Authentik, Keycloak, Zitadel, ...), without /.well-known/openid-configuration. Set the redirect URI at your provider to BETTER_AUTH_URL/api/auth/callback/oidc. Users must already exist in BorgWarehouse with the same email; SSO doesn't create accounts.

Config.Name: OIDC_CLIENT_ID
Config.Description: OIDC client ID.

Config.Name: OIDC_CLIENT_SECRET
Config.Description: OIDC client secret.

Config.Name: OIDC_PROVIDER_NAME
Config.Description: Label on the SSO login button. Defaults to SSO.

Config.Name: DISABLE_PASSWORD_LOGIN
Config.Description: Allow SSO login only. Only takes effect when an SSO provider is configured.

Config.Name: SETUP_SECRET
Config.Description: Passphrase required to complete the first-run setup wizard. Recommended if the web UI is reachable from the internet before you've created the admin account.

Config.Name: BETTER_AUTH_TRUSTED_ORIGINS
Config.Description: Other URLs you open BorgWarehouse at besides BETTER_AUTH_URL, comma separated, e.g. http://192.168.1.10:3000 when BETTER_AUTH_URL is your reverse proxy domain. Without this, logins from those addresses fail with Invalid origin.

Config.Name: SESSION_EXPIRY_SECONDS
Config.Description: Login session lifetime in seconds. Defaults to 3600 (1 hour).

Config.Name: FQDN_LAN
Config.Description: Optional local hostname or IP. BorgWarehouse then also shows backup commands for clients on your LAN.

Config.Name: SSH_SERVER_PORT_LAN
Config.Description: SSH port for the LAN commands, if different.

Config.Name: HIDE_SSH_PORT
Config.Description: Leave the port out of the commands BorgWarehouse shows (e.g. when clients set it in ~/.ssh/config).

Config.Name: MAIL_SMTP_HOST
Config.Description: SMTP server for email alerts.

Config.Name: MAIL_SMTP_PORT
Config.Description: SMTP port. Defaults to 587.

Config.Name: MAIL_SMTP_LOGIN
Config.Description: SMTP username.

Config.Name: MAIL_SMTP_PWD
Config.Description: SMTP password.

Config.Name: MAIL_SMTP_FROM
Config.Description: From address for alert emails.

Config.Name: MAIL_REJECT_SELFSIGNED_TLS
Config.Description: Set to false to accept a self-signed certificate on the SMTP server.

Config.Name: DISABLE_INTEGRATIONS
Config.Description: Turn off API tokens (integrations).

Config.Name: DISABLE_DELETE_REPO
Config.Description: Prevent anyone from deleting a repository.

Config.Name: DISABLE_COMPACT_REPO
Config.Description: Prevent anyone from compacting a repository.

Config.Name: STORAGE_TARGETS
Config.Description: Extra storage locations selectable per repository, comma separated, optionally path|name (e.g. /mnt/offsite|Offsite disk). Each path must also be added as a Path mapping to this container.

Config.Name: NEXT_TELEMETRY_DISABLED
Config.Description: 1 turns off Next.js anonymous telemetry.
